:::{#exr-linear-system-check}
#### Checking whether a vector solves a linear system

Checking whether a vector solves a [linear system](#def-linear-system) takes only one [matrix-vector product](#def-matvec-mult),
which is much less work than solving the system.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 1 \\ 1 & -2 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\vecf{b} = \begin{bmatrix} 5 \\ 4 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\vx = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ -1 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Is $\vx$ a [solution of $\matr{A}\vx = \vecf{b}$](#def-linear-system)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compute $\matr{A}\vx$ with @def-matvec-mult and compare it with $\vecf{b}$,
as in @exm-linear-system.

:::

:::
